cues.headline: GOAL! Teo Rossiter!
cues.body: Kingsford Rovers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 0–1 Kingsford Rovers. It came 18 seconds after Kingsford Rovers won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers have taken over: they've had the ball 64% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Just what Elmstead Wanderers need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 35%, Kingsford Rovers 65%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Yann Calloway scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 1–1 Kingsford Rovers. Against the run of play: Kingsford Rovers were in control.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.4 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers turn the screw
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are calling the shots now: winning the ball back in the opposition half 2 times in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: It's in! Hugo Zielin!
cues.body: Hugo Zielin finds the net for Kingsford Rovers: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Kingsford Rovers. It had been coming: Kingsford Rovers were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: GOAL! Cael Blackwood!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 2–2 Kingsford Rovers. Against the run of play: Kingsford Rovers were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 3.8 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: Elmstead Wanderers are on top
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers are on top: leaving Kingsford Rovers just 3.3 passes per defensive action and playing 12 progressive passes in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Teo Brennick scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 3–2 Kingsford Rovers. It had been coming: Elmstead Wanderers were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 3–2 Kingsford Rovers
recap.summary: A deserved win for Elmstead Wanderers.
